html: Version 0.2 schemas under schemas/v0.2/; the v0.1 schemas are unchanged at their paths and archived under schemas/v0.1/. The three existing entities gain an optional ext object keyed by profile namespace, with the named identifier keys refused at every depth; this is a key-based check, and an identifier inside a permitted string is not detected. WellbeingObservation, InstrumentAdministration, MeasurementContext and AggregateReport become executable schemas, with organisation scope, the context join both measurement entities lacked, occasion timestamps with asserted zones, a closed scoring descriptor and a report period with denominators. The validator adds --profile and rules C3 to C9, and a bundle checker applies the joins between records. absence-reason is 0.2.0: the ten substantive reason categories and the separate non-disclosure response in the ONS 2025 sickness absence workbook, replacing the six-category list that described itself as the ONS taxonomy, with a crosswalk from the legacy codes; org-size-band is 0.1.1, same codes and bounds, with inclusive bounds as metadata and an anchor that no longer calls them a Companies Act classification. The published v0.1 release archive (owhs-v0.1-bundle.zip) is unchanged; the first-set schemas, examples and checkers are in a separate owhs-v0.2-bundle.zip.
